reason: Builds on #1068 (its commits are included until batch 5 lands). Reads never admit a project worker, so a chatless project with no queued work never loaded Notes, Findings or Evidence (release blocker). An open project view now holds a keyed view lease (PUT/DELETE /api/v1/engagements/{project}/view-leases/{lease_id}) that the host's admission counts as demand like an open chat; expiry is database time; release ends the lease now so #1062's idle grace runs from the close; a memory-budget refusal is recorded as an admission hold and shown once as reason "held"; migration 0049 only adds two tables. Selected for the lease: test_project_view_leases.py (DB-time expiry and replayed PUT after expiry, refusals and per-actor cap, live view admits only its project, closed view keeps then spends the grace, no grace while another project waits for capacity, memory budget not bypassed, routes need auth but no Idempotency-Key, a project worker's ExecutionSQLScope rejects lease and hold writes, migration additive and downgrades to 0048), the runtime-compatibility review tests (migration tree and head 0049), test_execution_scope.py (worker guard deny-list), test_runtime_work_batches.py (admission and idle retirement incl. #1062's grace), the admission-retry cases that pass on main, the product-help checks for the documented lease and grace, vitest for the lease hook (renew, hidden page, pagehide, release) and tool assistance waiting for a starting worker, and the chatless-project journey (area project-view-lease) on desktop, Chromium 390 and WebKit 390. With view leases the pane journey's readmission comes from the open view itself (no Unarchive needed), so on this branch it asserts the calm wait and in-place recovery after coming back, then unarchives in place. Kept from #1068: Worker-backed GUI panes stayed in error after an idle project's worker retired and was readmitted, until a reload. Core now answers project reads without a ready worker with a coded, retryable 503 (project_runtime_unavailable + reason starting/closing/idle, Retry-After: 1) and the UI waits for the runtime instead of failing: one shared probe, every pane re-reads in place, one calm status line. Selected: test_api_worker.py (the coded 503 for each reason and the unchanged body for other private-channel failures, plus the existing API-worker contract), test_runtime_routing.py (the new idle/starting/closing reasons and the existing routing cases), test_runtime_http.py (the proxy codes only project reads; the host channel keeps its body), test_execution_worker.py except the flaky idle-probe case (a starting worker's coded 503, failed/fenced gates, the existing worker lifecycle), the playwright-impact manifest checks that pass on main (the catalog gained an area), the new and changed vitest suites for the recovery module, client, panes, workspace collections and subagents, plus existing suites around the changed client send path and app shell, and the new real-Core journey on desktop, Chromium 390 and WebKit 390. The journey now sets the fixture's idle grace to 0 (a test-fixture control only): since #1062 a quiet project's worker stays 300 s after its last command, and the journey's archive is such a command.
exclusions: Excluded because they fail on pristine origin/main 3c0481c: tests/v3/test_migrations.py (4 of 6 fail on main: the reversible-head downgrade now hits 0048's refusal, plus event-history and harness-title cases), test_admission_retry.py::test_transient_start_failure_retries_with_backoff_without_a_revision_change (postgresql fails on main under host load: 0.2 s backoff), test_product_knowledge.py::test_product_search_finds_headless_core_and_paired_butler_cli (fails on main), Still selected: test_api_worker.py::test_api_role_import_does_not_import_the_execution_factory_or_chat_runtime timed out once at its 15 s limit under host load ~78 locally; its import check passes when run alone (13.4 s wall). The other five project-view-lease catalog entries (compact, 320, 430) are catalogued but not selected to bound real-Core cost. From #1068: Excluded because they fail on pristine origin/main: test_execution_worker.py::test_idle_worker_makes_no_fenced_claims_and_still_picks_up_work (flaky: 1 of 4 runs on main and 1 of 3 on this branch fail on a FOR SHARE statement in the idle window), tests/test_playwright_impact.py::test_full_manifest_covers_every_product_browser_spec_without_filters, and ui/src/api/client.test.ts (3 resolveReceipt cases fail on main; the ui-receipts agent owns them). test_runtime_work_batch_integration.py is unchanged in the final diff. The other five runtime-pane-recovery catalog entries (compact, Chromium/WebKit 320 and 430) are catalogued but not selected to bound real-Core cost; the scratch LAN runs covered desktop Chromium 1440 and WebKit iPhone 13 390. The real-Core journey could not complete locally because the fixture's worker starts time out on this host (load ~40): its calm idle state, no alerts, axe and hit-test assertions passed on desktop before readmission exceeded 120 s.
